title: Writing Center Hours
transcript: Hi everyone, I want to let you know about some changes at the writing center. Starting next week, we'll be open on Sunday afternoons, which students have been asking about for a long time. At the same time, Friday hours will end at three instead of five. Tutoring sessions still last thirty minutes. Appointments are strongly recommended, but we'll take walk-ins whenever a tutor is free.

questions.stem: Why does the speaker mention that students have been asking about Sunday hours?
options: To explain why the center needs more tutors
To show the change responds to student requests
To complain that students ask too many questions
To announce that Sunday hours are canceled
questions.explanation: Sunday hours are being added because students have been asking for them.

questions.stem: What is said about walk-in students?
options: They will be seen if a tutor is available
They can only stay for fifteen minutes
questions.explanation: Walk-ins are accepted whenever a tutor is free.
